title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-stack e-commerce solution with product catalog, cart, checkout, and admin dashboard.
shortDescription: Full-stack e-commerce solution with Next.js, MongoDB, and Stripe integration.
overview: A production-ready e-commerce platform built with modern web technologies. Supports product browsing, user authentication, shopping cart, and secure payment processing.
features: Product catalog with search and filtering
challenges: Handling real-time inventory updates across concurrent users while maintaining data consistency and preventing overselling.
solution: Implemented optimistic locking with MongoDB transactions and a queue-based inventory sync system to ensure accurate stock levels.
architecture: Monolithic Next.js app with API routes, MongoDB for persistence, and Stripe webhooks for payment events.

title: Task Management App
description: A collaborative task management tool with real-time updates, team boards, and project tracking.
shortDescription: Collaborative task management tool with real-time updates and team boards.
overview: A Kanban-style task management application designed for small teams. Features drag-and-drop boards, real-time collaboration, and activity tracking.
challenges: Synchronizing drag-and-drop state across multiple clients in real-time without conflicts or UI jank.
solution: Used Firebase Realtime Database with operational transforms and debounced write operations to keep all clients in sync smoothly.

title: Security Dashboard
description: A cybersecurity monitoring dashboard with real-time analytics, threat detection, and reporting.
shortDescription: Cybersecurity monitoring dashboard with real-time analytics and threat detection.
overview: An analytics dashboard for monitoring security events, visualizing threat patterns, and generating compliance reports for security teams.
challenges: Processing and visualizing high-volume security event streams without degrading dashboard performance.
solution: Implemented server-side aggregation with time-window bucketing and virtualized chart rendering for smooth performance at scale.
architecture: Next.js frontend with a Node.js event processing pipeline, PostgreSQL for event storage, and WebSocket connections for live updates.
